━━━ The way forward · part way ━━━
(edits message 42)
🧭 The way to becoming a town - Korendal

Korendal grows into a town by developing, not by taking more land: people, literacy, buildings, knowledge and a healthy treasury. These are the steps ahead:

▫️ Residents: 6 of 8
▫️ Literacy: 12% of 20%
▫️ Finished buildings (roads not counted): 3 of 5
✅ A food building (a farm or a pasture)
▫️ A teaching building (a teaching circle)
▫️ A health building (a health house)
▫️ Things the village learned itself (researched or bought): 1 of 2
✅ Treasury: 7,400 SUP of 2,000 SUP

Every step taken turns ✅ here. When all are ✅ the head gets the promotion button.
  ───
  [🔙 Back] → settlement:overview   │   [🔄 Refresh] → settlement:promotion.view

━━━ Promotion · confirm (town) ━━━
(edits message 42)
🚀 Promote Korendal to a town?

The village head becomes the town head and keeps leading; building opens up and new buildings and knowledge appear. Promotion is free and cannot be undone; the group is told.
  ───
  [✅ Yes, promote] → settlement:promote:confirm
  [🔙 Back] → settlement:promotion.view

━━━ Promotion · done (town) ━━━
(edits message 42)
🎉 Korendal is now a town!

The village head is now the town head. The town's new buildings and knowledge show in the build and knowledge lists, and the group has been told.
  ───
  [🏗 Construction] → settlement:build   │   [📚 Village knowledge] → settlement:knowledge
  [🔙 Back] → settlement:overview   │   [🔄 Refresh] → settlement:overview

━━━ Promotion · confirm (city) ━━━
(edits message 42)
🚀 Promote Korendal to a city?

The town head becomes the mayor and keeps leading; the city government with taxes, a council and elections starts. Promotion is free and cannot be undone; the group is told.
  ───
  [✅ Yes, promote] → settlement:promote:confirm
  [🔙 Back] → settlement:promotion.view
